catalogYearMetadata.name: Reviewed dated manufacturer market catalogs
catalogYearMetadata.description: Models explicitly offered or reported sold in a dated manufacturer catalog, sales release or offer. Years mean marketed catalog year, not manufacturer model year or vehicle manufacture year. Only documented individual years are included; no ranges are inferred. Per-row market, URL, year basis and rationale remain in data/evidence/manufacturer-reviewed.json.
